relations.relationship: Questions the binary and implicitly heterosexual restrictions reproduced when a single category of women becomes theory’s unquestioned starting point.
relations.evidence_note: Primary printed pp. 530–531 read. The argument preserves the political importance of representing women while contesting reification; not denial of lived experience or a fresh reading of every later queer-theory text.
